# Sentient Partners

> Sentient Partners is a local business and technology partner based in Auburn, California. It designs and builds websites, business applications and AI assistants (chat and voice) for growing small and mid-sized businesses in Placer County, Greater Sacramento and across Northern California. The firm is founder-led by Troy Hill, formerly Global Quality Director at Hewlett-Packard and Director of Enterprise Quality Assurance at E*TRADE.

Key facts:
- Location: Auburn, California. Serves Auburn, Placer County, Greater Sacramento and Northern California; also works with clients beyond the region.
- First step: a free 20-minute introductory call, booked at https://cal.com/sentient-partners-strategy/introductory-call
- Contact: hello@sentientpartners.ai · (415) 504-2757
- Founder: Troy Hill (https://www.linkedin.com/in/tghill/)
- AI assistants on client sites are always disclosed as AI and hand sensitive or complex requests to a person.
- Pricing is scoped per business after the introductory call; there are no published packages.

## Capabilities

- Premium websites: custom, mobile-first sites with clear messaging, hosting and care.
- Search visibility: business profile care, local service pages and sound technical foundations.
- Calendar and scheduling: online booking, team calendar sync, text and email reminders.
- Business applications: scheduling and dispatch, job notes and photos, invoices and payment links, owner dashboards.
- Workflow automation: connections between existing tools, readable rules, human approval steps, alerts when something stalls.
- Reputation and reviews: review requests to every customer, drafted responses the owner approves, monthly summaries.
- AI chat assistants: website, text and social assistants that answer routine questions, qualify inquiries and hand off with context.
- AI voice agents: after-hours and overflow call answering, urgency screening, summaries sent to the team.

## Who it helps

Local service businesses, trades and home services (HVAC, cleaning), professional services, fitness and wellness, retail and online stores, and new businesses getting started.
